title: Meio Bags
summary: Deletes your cheapest junk with one key when bags are full; vendors buy the rest.

gallery.title: Before and after
gallery.description: Full bags: Inventory is full, then one key press deletes the cheapest grey stack and says so in chat

gallery.title: Room for your loot
gallery.description: Loot won't fit: one press deletes junk from a bag the drop can go in, skipping cheaper junk in the Reagent Pouch, then loots it

gallery.title: Sold at the vendor
gallery.description: Open a vendor and your junk sells by itself; chat says how many items went and for how much

gallery.title: One stack per press
gallery.description: Each press deletes the next cheapest junk; a stack worth over 1 gold is kept for the vendor
